suggestions.title: Delete what the retired homepage film left behind: the #film-dialog CSS and the phantom browser-suite entry
suggestions.why: vitest.config.js:30 lists "tests/film-dialog.test.js" in BROWSER_SUITES, and tests/ holds no such file (the twelve files that import @playwright/test are exactly the other twelve entries), so the browser project's suite list records coverage that does not run; public/styles.css:1348-1394 still styles #film-dialog, .film-close, .film-foot, .film-evidence and .film-end for the homepage film that Issue #704 removed — "film-dialog" and "trace-film" match nothing in site/, public/*.html or public/demo.js.
suggestions.body:
## Request

Delete the two leftovers of the homepage film that Issue #704 removed:

1. `public/styles.css` lines 1348-1394 — the `/* Issue #571: the homepage film dialog ... */` comment and the rules that follow it (`#film-dialog`, `#film-dialog::backdrop`, `#film-dialog video`, `.film-close`, `.film-close:hover`, `.film-foot`, `.film-evidence`, `.film-evidence .film-evidence-a`, `.film-evidence .film-evidence-a:hover`, `.film-end`, `.film-end[hidden]`).
2. `vitest.config.js` line 30 — the `"tests/film-dialog.test.js"` entry in `BROWSER_SUITES`.

## User outcome

Nothing on the page changes: no shipped markup can use those rules, so the deleted CSS is invisible. What a maintainer gets is a browser-suite list in `vitest.config.js` that names only suites that exist, and a hand-written stylesheet that no longer carries a component the site deleted.

## Acceptance

- `grep -rn "film-dialog\|film-close\|film-foot\|film-evidence\|film-end" public/ site/ tests/ scripts/` returns nothing.
- The diff of `public/styles.css` contains only deleted lines; no surviving rule or declaration changes.
- `git diff vitest.config.js` removes exactly the one `BROWSER_SUITES` entry; every remaining entry resolves to a file (`for f in $(grep -o 'tests/[a-z-]*\.test\.js' vitest.config.js); do ls "$f"; done` succeeds).
- `npm test` passes, and `npm run test:ui` passes with the twelve remaining browser suites.
- Screenshots of `/` and `/zh/` at 1440 and 390 before and after the change look identical.

## Evidence

- `vitest.config.js:30` — `"tests/film-dialog.test.js",`. `ls tests/film-dialog.test.js` fails; `grep -ln '@playwright/test' tests/*.js` lists twelve files, matching the other twelve `BROWSER_SUITES` entries exactly.
- `public/styles.css:1348-1394` — the `#film-dialog` / `.film-*` block, still commented `Issue #571: the homepage film dialog`.
- No consumer: `grep -rn "film-dialog\|trace-film" site/ public/ --include=*.html --include=*.js` matches nothing; `tests/film.test.js` records that the homepage film was removed by Issue #704 and now covers only the Cloud merge-gate explainer.
- `tests/pages.test.js` compares the build output against `public/` byte for byte, so this change stays inside hand-written files the build never touches — no regeneration needed.

## Not included

- No change to `public/demo.js` (it has no film code left) and no re-adding of a film, dialog or video player.
- No change to the other twelve `BROWSER_SUITES` entries and no new browser suite.
- No general CSS cleanup beyond the deleted block.

suggestions.title: Add Keelen to the /compare/ capability matrix and matrix.csv
suggestions.why: site/pages/compare/index.html:149 opens the capability matrix, whose twelve rows cover Orbi plus eleven vendors and stop before Keelen, while site/pages/compare/keelen/index.html publishes "Orbi vs Keelen" with its own sourced table (keelen.ai, verified 2026-09-24) and the /compare/ dive list links it; public/compare/matrix.csv repeats the same twelve rows and scripts/build-pages.mjs:1667 embeds that file into public/llms-full.txt, so the omission also reaches the copy AI readers get.
suggestions.body:
## Request

Give Keelen a row in the `/compare/` capability matrix, in all three places the matrix lives:

- `site/pages/compare/index.html` — the `<table class="compare-table ... capability-matrix">` rows.
- `site/pages/zh/compare/index.html` — the same row in the Chinese matrix.
- `public/compare/matrix.csv` — the matching CSV line.

Then run `npm run build` and commit the regenerated `public/compare/index.html`, `public/zh/compare/index.html` and `public/llms-full.txt` with the source change.

## User outcome

A reader who lands on `/compare/` after the Orbi-vs-Keelen page can see Keelen's documented capabilities in the same table as every other vendor, and the CSV download and the `llms-full.txt` copy carry Keelen too — instead of a matrix that silently drops one of the products the site compares against.

## Acceptance

- Both matrices contain a `<tr data-product="Keelen">` row with all six columns (`independent_review`, `blocks_merge_on_findings`, `merges_the_pr`, `publishes_the_release`, `self_host`, `license`), and every cell links to its dated source, as the other rows do.
- `public/compare/matrix.csv` has one Keelen line whose six values and `verified` date equal the HTML row.
- `tests/pages.test.js` "comparison capability matrix" stays green in both of its checks: HTML row/column sets equal the CSV, and every cell carries an `https://` source link.
- Cell values are transcribed from `/compare/keelen/`'s own sourced table and nothing else. That page states review gates (red-first proof, separate adversarial review, project tests, required checks), merge ("green and gated means merged"), tag/release as not described, and a self-hosted runner option for Enterprise. A column the page does not state reads `not documented` — never `no`, following the matrix's existing rule that only official documentation saying so earns a "no".
- `npm run build` then `npm test` pass; `public/llms-full.txt` contains the Keelen row.
- Screenshots of `/compare/` and `/zh/compare/` at 1440 and 390 show the wider table scrolling inside its own frame, with no page-level horizontal scroll and no truncated cells.

## Evidence

- `site/pages/compare/index.html:149` — `<section class="compare-section shell" aria-labelledby="matrix-title">`; its rows run Orbi, Orca, OpenClaw, GitHub Copilot cloud agent, Claude Managed Agents, Claude Code, OpenHands, Hermes Agent, OpenAI Codex, Devin, Google Jules, Cursor Cloud Agents. Keelen is absent.
- `public/compare/matrix.csv` — twelve data rows, the same twelve products, with per-row `source_url` and `verified` columns (Orbi 2026-09-17, the rest 2026-09-07 or later).
- `site/pages/compare/keelen/index.html` — a published detail page: comparison table with review gates, merge, tag/release, self-hosting and price, each linked to `https://keelen.ai/`, and a provenance section dated `verified 2026-09-24`.
- `docs/comparison-audit.md` records the matrix's Tag/Release row rule as "Official absence (11 vendors' official docs)" — the eleven vendor rows are exactly the matrix's non-Orbi rows, so Keelen was never part of the audited set rather than audited and excluded.
- `scripts/build-pages.mjs:1667` reads `public/compare/matrix.csv` into `renderLlmsFull`, which is why the generated `llms-full.txt` inherits the gap.
- `site/pages/compare/index.html` already links `/compare/keelen/` from its dive list, so the page is discoverable from the index that does not list it in the matrix.

## Assumptions

- Keelen's absence from the matrix is an omission, not a deliberate exclusion. If it was deliberate, say so and close this without a code change; the finding then belongs in `docs/comparison-audit.md` as a recorded decision.

## Not included

- No new vendor research and no re-verification of `keelen.ai`: the row records what `/compare/keelen/` already states, carrying that page's 2026-09-24 date.
- No change to any existing row, to the matrix's columns, or to the `/compare/keelen/` page copy.
- No capability-matrix row for any vendor other than Keelen.
